business_problem: BCI is removing manual tasks through automation and Copilot features that streamline report writing, offering employees more time for strategic and creative tasks.
solution_summary: BCI is removing manual tasks through automation and Copilot features that streamline report writing, offering employees more time for strategic and creative tasks. Canadian asset-management firm British Columbia Investment Management Corporation (BCI) is harnessing the capabilities of Microsoft 365 Copilot and the Microsoft Azure ecosystem to elevate the employee experience and transform operations. BCI increased productivity by 10%-20% for 84% of Copilot users and increased their job satisfaction by 68%. The business saved more than 2,300 person-hours with automation, reduced the time spent on writing internal audit reports by 30% and saved one month of processing time to analyze 8,000 survey comments. In today's ever-evolving economic landscape, financial services organizations are turning to generative AI-powered solutions to transform business operations and support employee efficiency.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs the large-language-model features for classification, summarization, retrieval, or conversational responses in the solution.

solution_components.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
solution_components.role: Assists employees inside Microsoft 365 apps with drafting, summarization, analysis, and task execution.

solution_components.name: Microsoft 365
solution_components.role: Provides the collaboration and productivity applications where employees consume the new workflows.
